criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: Symptoms & Diagnosis
categories.definition: User asks about specific symptoms, how to identify or diagnose the virus, or whether they are infected.

categories.name: Transmission & Risk Factors
categories.definition: User inquires about how the virus spreads, risk levels in specific areas, or the likelihood of contracting it.

categories.name: Prevention & Safety Measures
categories.definition: User seeks advice on protective behaviors, hygiene, social distancing, or safety in public spaces.

categories.name: Treatments & Cures
categories.definition: User asks about medical treatments, cures, vaccines, or home remedies for the virus.

categories.name: Surface Survival & Cleaning
categories.definition: User asks about the virus surviving on specific surfaces or how to clean and disinfect objects.

categories.name: Travel & Movement
categories.definition: User asks about travel restrictions, safety of travel modes, or permission to travel to specific locations.

categories.name: Animals & Pets
categories.definition: User asks about the virus affecting animals, pets, or transmission via insects and wildlife.

categories.name: Statistics & Data
categories.definition: User requests specific numbers regarding cases, deaths, testing rates, or recovery rates.

categories.name: News & Updates
categories.definition: User requests the latest news, press releases, or general updates on the situation.

categories.name: Myths & Misinformation
categories.definition: User asks about specific myths, rumors, or the validity of unverified information regarding the virus.

categories.name: Donations & Financial Help
categories.definition: User expresses a desire to donate money, fund causes, or help financially.

categories.name: Sharing & Social
categories.definition: User requests to share the service, information, or link with others.

categories.name: Greetings & Gratitude
categories.definition: User greets the bot, checks its status, or expresses thanks and appreciation.

categories.name: General Information
categories.definition: User requests broad, non-specific information or a definition of the virus.
